interactive._note: Interactive layer (clutch launch rule off) vs MATLAB R1. Justified in docs/validation_report.md section 5: the only modelling difference on these runs is direct PCHIP torque vs the 50-rpm table + linear interpolation; its acceleration gap integrated open-loop along the MATLAB trajectories is <= 0.022 km/h (S07), so 0.05 km/h is ~2x that bound. Distance tolerance follows as v_tol/3.6 * t (used by the xUnit test). Time to reach L_recta: one step (dt = 0.005 s).
